section.sectionSummaryBrief: Another explanation of "Return O Israel until Hashem your G-d" is that teshuvah must be until Hashem is only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem.
section.t: And another explanation of "Return O Israel until Hashem your G-d,"
that the teshuvah must be until Hashem is only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem.
And the difference between the two explanations is,
that according to the explanation of "until Hashem your G-d" that Hashem will be your G-d, your power and vitality,
what is drawn in revelation is the names Hashem and Elokim, except that the connection of the two names is through a drawing from the Ein Sof that is above Hashem and Elokim.
And according to the explanation of "until Hashem your G-d" that Hashem will be only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem,
the light itself
(which is above Hashem)
is drawn in revelation.
For this, that Hashem becomes a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem, is specifically when this light shines in revelation.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The difference between the two explanations is analogous to the difference between the shofar blast and the recitation of the Shofarot verses.
section.t: And it can be said,
that the difference between the two explanations is analogous to the difference between the shofar blast and the recitation of the Shofarot verses.
For it is explained in the Hemshech of 5666,
that Malchuyot and Zichronot are in the light that fills and the light that surrounds,
and the drawing through the shofar is from the Ein Sof that is above the filling and surrounding,
and up to the drawing from the concealment of the Essence,
that through this drawing the unification of the surrounding and filling is effected.
And the drawing
through the recitation of the Shofarot verses is higher even than the drawing through the shofar blast.
For the drawing through the shofar blast is only the surrounding light and the filling light,
except that because the drawing is from the Ein Sof
[and higher than the concealment of the Essence],
they become connected and unified.
And through the recitation of the Shofarot verses, the concealment of the Essence itself is drawn,
in the manner of the revelation that will be in the future.
And this is
what in the Shofarot verses they recite the Shofarot verses of the Giving of the Torah and conclude with the matter of the shofar of the future,
for in the future there will be the revelation of the concealment of the Essence.
And likewise was the revelation at the Giving of the Torah.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The shofar of the future is superior to the shofar of the Giving of the Torah, and through the service of Rosh Hashanah the aspect of "He will blow a great shofar" is drawn.
section.t: And behold, the shofar of the future is more elevated than the shofar of the Giving of the Torah,
as it is brought in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer
regarding the two horns of the ram of Yitzchak,
that the right horn is larger than the left,
for with the left He blew at Mount Sinai and with the right He will blow in the future to come.
And also in the shofar of the future itself there are several levels,
"And Ad-noy Elokim will blow a shofar,"
"and He will blow a great shofar."
For "Ad-noy Elokim" are names,
except that these names
(Ad-noy Elokim with the vowelization of Elokim)
are most elevated,
as explained at length in Likkutei Torah.
For this revelation will be at the beginning of the redemption.
And afterwards "He will blow a great shofar,"
"He will blow" without specifying who is the blower,
for this blowing is a drawing and revelation from the aspect of the Concealment of all Concealments.
And it can be said,
that this, that in the Shofarot verses of Rosh Hashanah they also recite the verse "He will blow a great shofar,"
is,
because through the service of Rosh Hashanah they also draw this matter.
And based on this it can be said,
that this, that they say in the haftarah of Shabbat Shuvah "Return O Israel until Hashem your G-d,"
that in this Hashem is also included the matter of "Hashem Ad-noy" with the vowelization of Elokim, which is a most elevated level,
and nevertheless they say that teshuvah must be until Hashem is only a level of Elokim and tzimtzum relative to the Ein Sof that is above Hashem,
because through the service of Rosh Hashanah they also draw the matter of "He will blow a great shofar,"
and relative to this level,
even the name Hashem Ad-noy is considered like Elokim.
